text:
Amir Patel: Quick q — we're finalizing how plan tiers map to enforcement. Do we want Free to have a soft burst bucket (drains separately until monthly reset) or just hard throttle once you hit the free cap? Also how to treat per-key vs per-org enforcement?

Maria Chen: Product leaning: Free should allow a small soft burst. better dev onboarding, less surprise hard cutoffs. But need visible signals in the console. :eyes:

Ben Ortiz: Platform tradeoffs: soft burst adds state + refill logic. If we do it, I'd advocate a tokenized burst bucket with fixed capacity + refill interval. Implementation is straightforward but we must be explicit about billing semantics.

Leah Kumar: Billing question: if burst is allowed on paid plans, does overflow auto-bill or do we block until customer upgrades? For Free we can't bill, so it must be limited and not silently charge.

Sasha Ivanov: Telemetry request: include metrics event "quota.burst_used" and tags: plan, org_id, key_id, burst_remaining. Also expose burst_remaining on the per-key row in the console.

Ben Ortiz: Draft config snippet to discuss:

```yaml
plans:
  free:
    monthly_limit: 100000
    burst:
      capacity: 5000
      refill_interval: 60s
      invoice: false
  pro:
    monthly_limit: 1000000
    burst:
      capacity: 50000
      refill_interval: 60s
      invoice: true
  enterprise:
    monthly_limit: null
    burst: null
```

Ben Ortiz: Key notes: - free -> per-key enforcement with soft-burst on key, no billing. - pro -> per-org aggregation + burst that can overflow to billable usage. - enterprise -> negotiated limits / dedicated capacity (no soft-burst fallback).

Amir Patel: So enforcement tiers: per-key for free to limit blast radius, per-org for paid to allow internal sharing. That sounds right. Any objections?

Leah Kumar: Agree. For pro: if burst.invoice==true we need an explicit invoice event and line item. Make sure usage reconciliation handles mid-month upgrades/downgrades.

quota-bot: Simulated enforcement run: key=abc123 used=6200 burst_left=1800 status=ok

Maria Chen: UX ask: console should show "burst budget used" on the rate limit card + CTA "request extension" for free tier (links to support flow). Also show predicted month-end burn if current rate continues.

Sasha Ivanov: Small API change: return headers X-Quota-Remaining, X-Quota-Burst-Remaining, X-Quota-Used to make integrations easier.

Ben Ortiz: Implementation plan: feature flag + telemetry in sprint 1 (2 weeks), enforcement and per-org aggregation in sprint 2, billing linkage + invoices in sprint 3. Can do a soft rollout behind flags.

Amir Patel: Sounds good. I'll draft a PR for the plans matrix + enforcement rules. Can someone add the console mockups and telemetry schema? @Maria Chen @Sasha Ivanov?

Maria Chen: On it, will upload a mock tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Sasha Ivanov: I'll send the telemetry schema and header proposal by EOD.

Ben Ortiz: I'll start the backend PR and wire feature flags.

Amir Patel: Thanks team — moving this into a tracked ticket.
